title: 428 Red Cedar Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 428 Red Cedar Way is a 5.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 14) - 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- 6 Passenger Street Legal Electric Cart- Parking for 2 Vehicles- Private Elevator- 2 Fireplaces - Outdoor Summer Kitchen with Built-In Natural Gas Grill - Exterior Shower - Exterior Half Bath - Private Pool with Spa (complimentary pool heating available October 1-May 1)- 5 Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor- 5 Minute Golf Cart Ride to the WaterColor Beach Club- 6 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to 428 Red Cedar Way, an elegant three-story, 5,000-square-foot retreat in WaterColor’s Camp District. With space for up to 16 guests, a private pool and spa, and a central location, this home is perfectly crafted for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends. From the moment you arrive, wraparound porches invite you in to relax. Inside, natural light fills the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas, where thoughtful details create a warm, inviting space. The gourmet chef’s kitchen, with granite countertops and top-of-the-line appliances, flows into a dining area with seating for eight, plus four more at the breakfast bar. The main floor also offers a cozy guest room with a king bed and access to the porch. On the second floor, the luxurious master suite features a king bed, wood-burning fireplace, and private balcony overlooking the pool. Its ensuite bathroom boasts a jetted tub, walk-in shower, and marble finishes. Additional king and queen bedrooms on this floor each have their own private baths and charming porches. The third floor offers a casual lounge with a sectional sofa and large TV, two custom twin-over-queen bunk beds, and another master suite with a king bed, desk, and spa-like bathroom, making this level ideal for families. Outdoors, a fully equipped summer kitchen with a gas grill, dining area, and large TV sets the stage for memorable evenings. Lounge by the heated pool and spa, nestled against the nature reserve, or rinse off in the outdoor shower after a beach day. With elegant design, ample space, and Southern charm, 428 Red Cedar Way is the ultimate 30A getaway. Let Sanders Beach Rentals help you plan a vacation filled with cherished memories. FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Shared Bathroom with Walk In Shower - Kitchen- Living Room- Dining Area- Laundry Room SECOND FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower and Jacuzzi Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Combination - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower THIRD FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower And Jacuzzi Tub- Open Living Space with Bunk Nook: Living Room Area with Two Twin Over Queen Bunks (6), Shared Bathroom in Hall with Walk In Shower
